full_prompt_en: An expressive watercolor portrait brings a thoughtful young woman's face out of broad white paper. She turns slightly to the right, eyes lowered, with a quiet parted mouth. Her features are only partly complete: one eye and brow are sharply drawn in dark blue-black, while the far eye, cheek, and chin dissolve into thin pale washes. Around the left side of her head, saturated indigo, ultramarine, olive green, and a small burst of mustard yellow bloom into irregular organic shapes. Several narrow drips descend from these dense color areas past the face and into the blank lower margin. The white of the paper forms the brightest planes of forehead, nose, and cheek; no opaque white paint needs to be added. Fine pencil-like lines mark eyelashes, lip edges, and faint facial construction, but most boundaries remain fluid. Water has carried pigment beyond the drawn contour, creating soft cauliflower edges, transparent overlaps, and accidental splashes. The image is cropped very close, so the face fills the left and middle while a broad clean white interval remains at right. Cool blue-gray shadows model the eye socket and underside of the chin, offset by small warm yellow and rose notes. Light is implied through untouched paper and translucent wash rather than a specific source. The portrait feels vulnerable and immediate, suspended between careful observation and the unpredictable flow of watercolor.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅表现性水彩肖像让若有所思的年轻女子面容从大片白纸中浮出。她略向右转，眼低垂，嘴微张。五官仅部分完成：一只眼与眉以深蓝黑锐绘，远眼、面颊与下巴则溶入薄浅罩染。头左侧，饱和靛蓝、群青、橄榄绿与小片芥黄向不规则有机形晕开。几道窄流痕从密色区域下行，越过脸进入空白下缘。纸白构成额、鼻和颊的最亮平面，不必添加不透明白颜料。细铅笔般线标记睫毛、唇缘和模糊面部构造，但多数边界仍流动。水把颜料带过画定轮廓，形成柔花边、透明重叠和偶然飞溅。取景极近，脸填左和中部，右边仍留宽阔洁白间隔。冷蓝灰影塑造眼窝与下巴底，由少量暖黄、玫瑰点对位。光通过未涂的纸与半透明罩染暗示，而非特定光源。肖像脆弱、即时，悬在仔细观察与不可预测的水彩流动之间。
style_prompt_en: Expressive watercolor on white paper combines a few sharply observed dark lines with loose transparent pigment blooms. Indigo, ultramarine, slate blue, olive, and small mustard or rose accents gather asymmetrically on one side, while large untouched white areas remain essential to the light. Water-driven edges bleed, feather, and overlap; thin vertical drips extend the color beyond the main shape. Some focal details stay crisp and nearly black, but adjacent contours are incomplete or dissolve into pale gray-blue wash. The surface shows paper brightness, accidental splatter, translucent layering, and the varying density of pooled pigment. Close cropping gives the painted cluster presence without filling the whole field. Light is created by restraint: open paper and pale wash contrast with concentrated dark marks. The effect is intimate, fluid, and emotionally exposed, balanced between disciplined drawing and material chance.
style_prompt_zh: 白纸上的表现性水彩把少数观察精确的深线与松动透明颜料晕染结合。靛蓝、群青、石板蓝、橄榄和小片芥黄或玫瑰强调不对称地聚在一侧，大片未涂白区仍是光的关键。水驱边缘渗开、羽化并叠压；细竖流痕把颜色带出主体形。一些焦点细节保持锐利近黑，邻近轮廓则不完整或溶入浅蓝灰罩染。表面显纸亮、偶然飞溅、透明层叠与颜料积水密度变化。近裁幅给予颜料簇存在感，却不填满整个场。光由克制创造：开放纸与浅罩染对比集中深痕。效果亲密、流动且情感袒露，在纪律性起稿与材料偶然之间平衡。
theme_en: A thoughtful face emerges from blue and olive watercolor on white paper
theme_zh: 一张若有所思的脸从白纸上的蓝与橄榄水彩中浮现
name: Agnes Cecile
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
